title: Quantinuum Reports 99.9995% Logical Fidelity on Helios, 10x Error-Correction Record
detail: Quantinuum announced an error-correction result on its Helios system with logical fidelity of 99.9995% (about five errors per million operations), claimed as a 10x improvement on the prior record and validating its path to fault-tolerant quantum computing by 2029.

media.caption: Quantum computing feat brings the megaquops era closer
